stories.title: TikTok Launches AI Shopping Assistant and 'Buy Direct' One-Click Checkout at Advertising Week New York
stories.body: On October 5, 2026, TikTok unveiled two agentic commerce tools at Advertising Week New York: Shopping Assistant, a conversational AI agent that retains user preferences and provides real-time guidance on sizing, shipping, and availability; and Buy Direct, a one-click in-app checkout that lets users purchase from a brand's For You feed without leaving the app. The tools are being co-built with Salesforce, Shopify, Shoplazza, and Stripe and are enabled by Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) integration. TikTok framed this as the first of several agentic commerce experiences, while simultaneously launching marketer-side tools including Agentic Leads — signaling a full-stack AI commerce infrastructure play.
stories.why: This is a direct threat and opportunity for any $100M+ brand: TikTok is collapsing the discovery-to-checkout funnel into a single in-app AI interaction, bypassing traditional DTC storefronts. For a Graas salesperson, it's the clearest current proof point that brands need AI-native commerce infrastructure — catalog readiness, agentic channel optimization, and performance measurement across feed-based checkout — or risk being invisible in the next generation of shopping.

stories.title: Retailers Draw Battle Lines on AI Agents: QVC Says Yes, Amazon Says No, Walmart Bets on Sparky
stories.body: About 61 million U.S. consumers now start shopping research with AI, yet 59.7% of the most recent AI-assisted purchases still closed on Amazon's own website — a tension that is forcing every major retailer to choose a stance. QVC lets agents complete purchases end-to-end; Tapestry sells through Google's AI tools but bars agents from its own checkout; and Amazon blocks outside agents entirely while building its own. Walmart is threading the needle: when a shopper selects a Walmart item inside Google Gemini, Walmart's Sparky agent takes over the basket, keeping the customer relationship in-house.
stories.why: This story crystallizes the strategic fork every retail brand faces right now: build your own agent layer, join a platform's agent ecosystem, or get bypassed entirely. Graas salespeople can use this as a direct 'have you chosen your agentic posture?' opener with CMOs and Heads of Digital who are still in wait-and-see mode.

stories.title: McKinsey: IKEA's Chief Digital Officer on Navigating 'The Risk of Doing Everything But Maybe Nothing' in Agentic AI
stories.body: In a June 2026 interview published by McKinsey, Ingka Group Chief Digital Officer Parag Parekh — overseeing IKEA operations across 32 countries and approximately 87% of global IKEA retail sales — described how agentic AI and generative AI are shifting customer relationships from transactional to immersive. Parekh revealed that AI has already compressed interior design sessions from six hours of co-worker time to a fraction of that, a service that previously cost customers around €70 per session. The CDO's key warning: prioritizing which AI initiatives to pursue 'is as important as the ideas themselves,' flagging the organizational trap of spreading investment too thin.
stories.why: A C-suite-level case study from one of the world's largest retailers, published by McKinsey, is the gold standard 'have you seen this?' opener for enterprise commerce conversations. For Graas, it directly validates the argument that agentic AI must be sequenced and measured — exactly the kind of structured, data-driven commerce execution Graas enables.

stories.title: Amazon Opens Seller Central to Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and TikTok Shop — Free Multichannel Management for All Sellers
stories.body: At its annual Accelerate seller conference on September 24–25, 2026, Amazon announced free Multichannel Selling Tools built directly into Seller Central, allowing independent sellers to connect, manage listings, view orders, and fulfill across eBay, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and Walmart from a single dashboard at no additional cost. The tools are rolling out gradually to U.S. sellers over the coming months. The move gives Amazon unprecedented visibility into off-platform seller data and inventory flows across its four largest rivals simultaneously.
stories.why: Amazon is making a structural play to become the operating system of multichannel commerce — centralizing data from every major rival under its own roof. For Graas, this reframes the conversation with brands: as Amazon consolidates the seller layer, brands need an independent intelligence and performance layer that isn't captive to any single platform's data incentives.

stories.title: TikTok Shop Launches 20-Day Black Friday–Cyber Monday Campaign With 1,200%+ Product Catalog Expansion Since 2024
stories.body: On October 19, 2026, TikTok Shop officially announced its Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaign running November 11–30, its longest and most expansive holiday push to date. Since 2024, TikTok Shop has expanded its product selection across categories by more than 1,200%, with major retailers including Sephora, Michael Kors, Best Buy, Ulta Beauty, and Victoria's Secret joining the platform this year alone. The campaign runs alongside TikTok Shop's US gross merchandise value crossing $30 billion in the first half of 2026 — up sharply from a roughly $9 billion annualized run rate in mid-2025.
stories.why: TikTok Shop is no longer a test channel — it is a structural Q4 battleground with $30B+ in H1 GMV and every major retail brand now participating. For Graas, this is a concrete urgency trigger for any brand not yet optimized for TikTok Shop performance: the holiday window is weeks away and the algorithm favors brands already live, making this an immediate actionable conversation starter.
